definitions.explanation: Not yet decided or established; remaining unknown or variable.

examples.japanese: {日程|にってい}はまだ{不確定|ふかくてい}だ。
{不確定|ふかくてい}な{要素|ようそ}が{多|おお}くて{計画|けいかく}が{立|た}てにくい。
examples.english: There are too many uncertain factors to make a plan.

examples.japanese: {将来|しょうらい}の{収入|しゅうにゅう}が{不確定|ふかくてい}なため、{大|おお}きな{買|か}い{物|もの}は{控|ひか}えている。
examples.english: Because my future income is uncertain, I'm holding off on major purchases.

notes:
A Sino-Japanese compound ({不|ふ} negative + {確定|かくてい} definite/fixed) used in formal and semi-formal contexts. It describes situations, facts, or quantities that have not been settled or cannot be predicted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不確定|ふかくてい}{要素|ようそ} — uncertain factor/element
- {不確定|ふかくてい}{性|せい} — uncertainty (as a quality)
- {不確定|ふかくてい}{原理|げんり} — uncertainty principle (physics)
- {不確定|ふかくてい}な{情報|じょうほう} — unconfirmed information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不確か|ふたしか} — uncertain, vague; more subjective and colloquial, often about personal impressions or memory
- {未定|みてい} — undecided; specifically means a decision has not yet been made, while {不確定|ふかくてい} is broader and can mean inherently unknowable
- {曖昧|あいまい} — ambiguous, vague; focuses on lack of clarity rather than lack of determination
